meta.parties: Podi Nona v. Urban Council, Horana

rules.statement: The court dismissed the application for a writ of certiorari as the relationship between the parties was contractual, and the petitioner had other remedies available.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am of the view that the relationship between the parties was contractual and accordingly that the petitioner is not entitled to obtain a writ of certiorari. Another remedy was open to her."
